facts.fact: The World Bank mission reports a contracted System Integrator (Ooru) building a digital ID with working prototypes of a Verifiable Credentials Infrastructure and an electronic Signature service, with e-signature planned for May 2026.

systems.system: STP Digital Identity (bilhete de identidade, digital ID)

STP.note: The document states no link between the civil register and the ID system.
No enrolment count or share is stated; mass registration is only planned for early 2026.
No number at birth is mentioned.
The system is not yet in service and the document states no operating or ownership arrangement for it.
No public register is stated to be keyed on the ID number.

facts.fact: The World Bank mission reports a System Integrator contracted with INIC and DGRN to design and implement a new foundational digital ID, with launch planned by January 2026 and its enabling identity law still awaiting approval.
